mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT campus_code FROM location_campus_mapping WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY CASE campus_code WHEN 'SOUTH' THEN 1 WHEN 'NORTH' THEN 2 WHEN 'ONLINE' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END

SELECT

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO location_campus_mapping( location_name, campus_code, enabled, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES( #{locationName}, #{campusCode}, 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE campus_code = VALUES(campus_code), enabled = 1, updated_at = NOW()
